raw_record.question_text: There are 5 coins placed flat on a table according to the figure. What is the order of the coins from top to bottom?

method.method_draft: Build an overlap precedence graph from the visible occlusion boundaries. From the image, inspect each place where two labeled circular coins cross: the visible circular edge belongs to the coin on top, while the interrupted/hidden edge belongs to the lower coin. Read the key visual relations as C lies over A and E, E lies over D and A, D lies over A and B, and A lies over B. Use the text only to know the task is asking for a single top-to-bottom stacking order of the five coins. Then topologically sort these above/below relations to get C above E above D above A above B, so the order is (C, E, D, A, B).

推理：在 C 与相邻硬币的交界处，C 的边界压在 A 和 E 的边界上，所以 C 在 A、E 上方。E 与 D、A 的交界处显示 E 在 D 和 A 上方。D 与 A、B 的交界处显示 D 在 A 和 B 上方。A 与 B 的交界处显示 A 在 B 上方。因此得到上下关系链：C 在 E 上方，E 在 D 上方，D 在 A 上方，A 在 B 上方。按从上到下排序为 C, E, D, A, B。

method.method_draft: Use an iterative visual peeling strategy. First describe the image: five overlapping labeled coins are arranged with C on the right, E at lower right, D at lower left, A near the top center, and B on the left. Identify the current top coin as the one whose edge is not cut by any other coin at its overlaps; C is visually in front of the neighboring coins, so record C first and mentally remove it. Among the remaining coins, E is now the frontmost because its boundary covers the lower/right overlaps with the coins behind it, so record E next. After removing E, D is the next visible front coin over A and B. Removing D leaves A over B. Thus the peeled top-to-bottom sequence is C, E, D, A, B.
